body: This class will focus on developing a foundation on which you can build and evolve. The series is also designed to deepen your relationships to crystals and teach you new ways to use some of the most popular and powerful crystals. Through new practices and programs, you will create meaningful positive change and transformation in a short amount of time. This class highlights the first layer of any transformation: awareness. Through a heightened awareness and small shifts in your internal environment, you will be able to create a much bigger transformation in how you live your life. This class recording will walk you through a 21-day program, which you can repeat anytime you want to make a shift in your state of mind and approach to life. After this class, you will have the tools and foundation to move forward and learn the more advanced techniques to follow in the second and third classes in the series. The purchase of this online class is non-refundable. All sales are final.
